wish: someone should make a WYSIWYG geometry tool
spec:
A compass-and-straightedge board: points, segments, lines, circles and angles, with crossings you can pin as points; drag a point and every construction built on it follows, with lengths and angles updating live.
Pick a tool, tap the board (snaps to a 1-unit grid unless Snap is off), drag solid points in Move; Undo, Delete and Clear; the drawing is kept on this device.
It does not do coordinates algebra, export images, or construct perpendiculars and bisectors in one step: you build them with circles, as on paper.
notes: 1 unit = one grid square. Intersection points are dependent: they move with their parents and disappear when the curves stop crossing.
